text_block_list.text: —I am the prince of this kingdom.

Night after night, gorgeous and extravagant parties were held inside the castle.
Indulging in every luxury, feasting endlessly on lavish dishes.

However, I was dissatisfied with this kind of life.
Isn't there any way
to break free from this tedious routine...?
BAMMM!!

It happened in an instant!
Smashing right through the castle's outer wall,
a lone girl appeared!

We have finally arrived!
The Kingdom's castle!
How gorgeous, glittering, and beautiful it is!
It is truly a castle fit for me!

Oh, my! So you are the Prince!?
The Prince I've yearned for! The Prince of my dreams!

Allow me to introduce myself, then.
For I am... none other than—!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: I am Cinderella!

text_block_list.name: Stepmother
text_block_list.text:
C-Cinderella!?
Why are you here!?

text_block_list.name: Stepsister
text_block_list.text: I'm positive I left it at home, though?!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: I ran the full 100 kilometers under my own power!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
Over mountains, leaping across valleys,
smashing giant boulders, swimming through raging rapids...

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming every trial and tribulation,
I have finally arrived at the party of my dreams!

I still don't quite understand the situation,
but an incredible girl has arrived.

*gasp*! *pant*...!
H-Hey! Cinderella-!
W-Wait up-!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Oh? Who might you be?

Haa, phew...
H-Hold on a sec... Gimme water...
We just ran all that way too, you know...

*Gulp, gulp... Phaaah!*
Ready!? Listen and be amazed, Cinderella!
Believe it or not, my true identity is...!

text_block_list.name: Wizard
text_block_list.text: I'm a witch!
Did a witch just run 100 kilometers?!

And...! *pant*, *gasp*...!
M-Me and... *pant*, this girl will!

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fairy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm the wizard's... *gasp, wheeze*!
F-Fairy, alright...! *pant, huff*!

text_block_list.name: Wizard
text_block_list.text:
Cinderella! I was going to bestow
an amazing magic spell upon you...
and yet you ran all the way to the castle on your own!

text_block_list.name: Wizard
text_block_list.text:
I don't need a pumpkin carriage anymore.
Nor magic tools to cross steep mountains.
Um, let's see... what I need now is...

text_block_list.name: Scarlet Fairy
text_block_list.text:
"O witch!
In that case, a beautiful dress would be lovely!
After all, it's such a lavish party!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fairy
text_block_list.text:
No, you've got it all wrong, Scarlet!
What we need are glass slippers!
Super stylish and cool glass slippers!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet Fairy
text_block_list.text: What is it?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka Fairy
text_block_list.text: What the heck?!

text_block_list.name: Fairies
text_block_list.text: That's not good!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
Prince... whatever should I do?
A beautiful dress, or glass slippers...
Which one should I accept?
choice_data_list: You're wonderful just the way you are
You're wonderful just the way you are.
Let's build on your strengths even more!

text_block_list.name: Wizard
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeh...?!
You don't want either of them?!"

True beauty isn't about looks.
It's about what's in your heart and the actions that show it.
That's what I told Cinderella.

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
I see! They said so in my beloved PreFighter too!
"Never judge a person by their appearance!"

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
Which means...! Which means I am now
officially a princess, are you saying?!
choice_data_list: That's right! You are the true princess!
That's right! You are the true princess!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
*I* am the true princess!

text_block_list.name: Wizard
text_block_list.text: Aaargh! We came all this way, too~! This makes no sense at all~~!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A strong point...!?

To run the entire 100km of such a harsh road—
her powerful physical capability is truly magnificent.
She possesses the greatest talent!
choice_data_list: How about aiming to become an athlete with me!?
Why don't you pursue the path of an athlete with me!?

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
An athlete!
I'm... an athlete...!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text:
Which means... which means!
What I should ask from the wizard is...!

text_block_list.name: Cinderella
text_block_list.text: Training shoes, please!

text_block_list.name: Wizard
text_block_list.text:
"You can get stuff like that
even without magic, you know~~~!"
(Ringgggg...)
choice_data_list: Huh... Whew, it was just a dream.
